Specified route decision (logical names; router RTL is pending)

foot.text: The cases are independent illustrations, not a time sequence. CACHEABLE uses the shared CCU/LLC path; NORMAL_UNCACHED bypasses LLC allocation; MMIO bypasses CCU/LLC; UNMAPPED or a boundary-crossing span is rejected locally with no downstream request. Route rows are specification-level logical labels, not existing router RTL ports. No cycle latency or AXI response timing is defined by this figure.
